name: licence-position
title: Licence position working paper
for_each: select id,name from applications order by name

sections.title: Assessment
sections.note: Based only on recorded evidence. Complex licensing needs specialist review.

sections.title: Purchase proof
sections.sql: select reference,metric,quantity,starts_on,ends_on,evidence_ref,verified_by from entitlements where application_id=$1 order by reference

sections.title: Assignments
sections.sql: select c.name,c.kind,c.department,d.state,d.observed_on,d.last_used,d.release_evidence from deployments d join consumers c on c.id=d.consumer_id where d.application_id=$1 order by c.name

name: renewal-brief
title: Renewal decision brief
for_each: select distinct a.id,a.name from applications a join entitlements e on e.application_id=a.id where e.ends_on<=current_date+(select days from policy where key='renewal_days') order by a.name

sections.title: Rights and dates
sections.sql: select reference,quantity,starts_on,ends_on,evidence_ref from entitlements where application_id=$1 order by ends_on

sections.title: Notes and decisions
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from events where application_id=$1 order by created_at

name: reclaim-review
title: Removal evidence working paper
for_each: select id,name from applications order by name

sections.title: Candidates, no automatic removals
sections.sql: select c.name,c.kind,c.state as consumer_state,d.last_used,d.state as assignment_state,d.release_evidence,d.released_by,d.released_on from deployments d join consumers c on c.id=d.consumer_id where d.application_id=$1 order by c.name
